title: Category Manager - E-commerce
summary: An e-commerce category manager runs one product category on a marketplace or quick-commerce app as a small business. They decide what to sell, bring in sellers and brands, and set prices and promotions to grow sales (GMV) and margin, working with supply, marketing and operations teams.
dailyDuties: Review category GMV, margin and conversion each week
Find assortment gaps from search and sales data
Pitch and onboard new brands and sellers
Plan prices, deals and sale-event promotions
Negotiate margins and promotion funding with brands
Fix listing and catalogue quality issues
Work with supply teams on stock and fill rates

skills.expectation: Decide which products and brands the category should add, fix or drop, using search and sales data
Find, pitch and onboard new sellers and brands, and grow the existing ones
Set competitive prices and plan promotions and sale events with brand funding
Own the category's GMV (gross merchandise value) and margin targets
Keep product listings complete and accurate so customers can find and trust them
Negotiate margins, promotion funding and terms with brands and sellers
Build weekly category trackers and analyses in Excel
Work with supply, marketing, ops and finance teams to launch and grow selection
Understand quick-commerce dark stores and how fast delivery changes assortment
Track competitor platforms on price, selection and offers
Plan stock with supply teams to keep fill rates high
Pull category data with SQL queries
Plan sponsored ads and on-platform marketing with brands

certifications.why: Shows the Excel skills used for category trackers; no India category-management certification was found.
